name: IANA download, timer and confirmation
description: Browse the official IANA release history, wait, download published time zone data, and confirm before continuing.
intro: Welcome. We will read a real time zone release and verify the data the browser downloads from IANA.

steps.title: Open IANA Time Zones
steps.say: I type the IANA Time Zones address into the blank Chrome tab.

steps.title: Open IANA Release History
steps.say: From IANA's Time Zones page, I move to the Release History link and click it.

steps.title: Open the published release
steps.say: I select 2026f from IANA's release history and read its release notes.

steps.title: Pause on the release notes
steps.say: I leave these notes on screen for three seconds so the audience can read them.

steps.title: Download and confirm the data
steps.say: I download the data-only archive. Demio checks the browser's download and verifies the release inside it.
steps.wait: Check the download in Chrome, then choose Confirm.

steps.title: Return to release history
steps.say: I return to IANA's release history after confirming the download.

steps.title: Click the tab's close button
steps.say: I close the tab with its close button. The verified archive stays with this session until Stop.
